description: This Java class, LoanReAmortizationValidator, provides validation logic for re-amortization operations on loans within the Fineract project. It ensures that re-amortizations comply with business rules such as loan maturity, schedule type, interest bearing status, loan activity status, and transaction history constraints.

classes.name: LoanReAmortizationValidator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for validating loan re-amortization requests and business rules in the Fineract loan management system.

methods.name: validateReAmortize
methods.description: Validates a re-amortization request for a given loan and command, checking both the request parameters and business-specific rules.

methods.name: validateReAmortizeRequest
methods.description: Validates specific request parameters such as external ID for re-amortization.

methods.name: validateReAmortizeBusinessRules
methods.description: Checks global business rules, such as maturity date, schedule type, interest bearing status, loan activity status, and transaction frequency.

methods.name: validateUndoReAmortize
methods.description: Validates the conditions to undo a re-amortization for a loan.

methods.name: validateUndoReAmortizeBusinessRules
methods.description: Ensures that undo operations are valid, such as existing re-amortization transaction and absence of subsequent payments.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationErrorsExist
methods.description: Throws a validation exception if any parameter validation errors are found.

methods.name: transactionHappenedAfterOther
methods.description: Compares two transactions to determine if one occurred after the other, used to validate repayment timing post re-amortization.
